title: Prisma Dual Decurions
extract:
The Prisma Dual Decurions is the Prisma variant of the  Dual Decurion twin Archgun rifles, boasting higher critical chance, fire rate, status chance, and accuracy.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Good ammo efficiency, generating relatively small cooldown for the Archgun Deployer for every second fired.
Short reload delay of 0.25 seconds in Archwing mode.
Tied with  Dual Decurion for the second fastest reload speed of all Archguns in Atmospheric mode, behind  Cyngas.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
High crit chance (30.00%)
Very high burst DPS (3740)
High sustained DPS (2936.93)
Above average magazine size (64)
Above average total damage (220)
Very high reload speed (1.40 s)
High ammo max (512)
High fire rate (12.50 attacks/sec)
Above average damage per shot (299.2)
High crit multiplier (2.20x)
Disadvantages over other Archgun (Atmosphere)   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has notable recoil which throws off accuracy at medium-long range shooting.
Normal Attack (wiki attack index 1)
Below average status chance (24.00%)
See WARFRAME Wiki:Stat Comparison/Percentiles for more details.

Comparisons:

 Prisma Dual Decurions (Normal Attack), compared to  Dual Decurion (Normal Attack):
Equal base damage
Higher base critical chance (30.00% vs. 28.00%)
Higher base status chance (24.00% vs. 14.00%)
Higher average damage per tap (149.6 vs. 146.96)
Higher burst DPS (1870 vs. 1531.32)
Higher sustained DPS (1387.59 vs. 1187.25)
Higher fire rate (12.50 attacks/sec vs. 10.42 attacks/sec)
Tighter first-shot spread (0.50° vs. 7.00°)
Wider maximum spread (12.00° vs. 9.00°)
Greater projectile speed (300.0 m/s vs. 220.0 m/s)
Lower disposition (●●●●○ (1.25x) vs. ●●●●○ (1.30x))

Acquisition
The Prisma Dual Decurions is potentially sold by Baro Ki'Teer in the Concourse section of the Tenno Relay for  175,000 and  525. Note that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and this weapon may not be available on a succeeding appearance.
The weapon can be traded, but only for unranked copies without Forma and Orokin Catalyst installed.

Trivia
When used by Necramechs, instead of dual wielding it only uses a single Decurion.

Bugs
Despite not being hitscan in Archwing mode, this weapon doesn't display lead indicators.
